key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often the helper is run to refresh usage data. The countdown in the panel updates independently and does not cost a request.

key.name: panel-limit
key.description: Show the 5-hour session limit, the weekly limit, or whichever limit is currently closest to being used up.

key.name: panel-show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage in the panel
key.description: Show the used percentage next to the panel icon.

key.name: panel-show-time
key.summary: Show the time until reset in the panel
key.description: Show how long until the shown limit resets.

key.name: notify-on-problem
key.summary: Notify when usage data cannot be refreshed
key.description: Send a desktop notification when the extension starts showing stale data, for example after Claude Code's sign-in token expires. Sent once per transition, never repeated while the problem persists.

key.name: check-for-updates
key.description: Ask GitHub whether a newer release exists: once when the extension starts, and a few times a day after that. Turning this off stops the extension contacting GitHub at all, and hides the update notice.

key.name: theme-variant
key.summary: Which style sheet to layer on top of the shell theme
key.description: auto inherits everything from the active shell theme, which is what makes the extension follow Yaru's accent colour and light/dark variants. The other values load an explicit override from the themes directory.

key.name: claude-config-dirs
key.description: Directories to read accounts from. Empty means auto-detect: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set, otherwise ~/.claude.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Identifiers of the usage providers to collect data from.
